quest.0055C66103106D86.quest_desc: Craft the Kinetic Frame from the recovered schematic and the certified Create line.
The recipe consumes the schematic. This task verifies the completed frame without consuming it.
en_us.quest.0055C66103106D86.title: Kinetic Frame
quest.009699B43C7576E8.quest_desc: A circle is still a circuit if everyone agrees where current enters.
en_us.quest.009699B43C7576E8.title: Ritual Geometry
quest.00EB5746A726C5B4.quest_desc: Guardian corruption was systematic. Someone taught defense systems to survive their purpose.
en_us.quest.00EB5746A726C5B4.title: Corruption Index
quest.0105CB39F994B579.quest_desc: The Cascade reached downward by two routes and apologized by neither.
en_us.quest.0105CB39F994B579.title: Two Depths
quest.0133A61DB9FB84AC.quest_desc: A chamber that soaks matter in Source. It has no wires and I resent it.
Note from the engineering side of my personality: it still obeys throughput math. Whatever the Undercurrent is, it respects queues.
en_us.quest.0133A61DB9FB84AC.title: The Imbuement Chamber
quest.025D341769E84821.quest_desc: The temple amplifies a signal no living architect signed.
en_us.quest.025D341769E84821.quest_subtitle: Trace the echo to its source.
en_us.quest.025D341769E84821.title: Ancient Temple
quest.02BA27AF63721ACA.quest_desc: Build two Crushing Wheels and process Mekanism raw osmium through the AFTERLIGHT bridge recipe.
The wheels produce osmium dust. Keep their output visible before connecting the next machine.
en_us.quest.02BA27AF63721ACA.quest_subtitle: A bridge recipe gives raw osmium a mechanical entrance.
en_us.quest.02BA27AF63721ACA.title: Create Crushing
quest.03220200E8B9DBF4.quest_desc: Autocraft 256 Quartz Glass in one order.
The task verifies the completed quantity. The crafting monitor is your proof of provenance.
en_us.quest.03220200E8B9DBF4.quest_subtitle: A useful request is large enough to expose starvation.
en_us.quest.03220200E8B9DBF4.title: 256-Item Order
quest.035F257B1640AD1D.quest_desc: Build a Laser Arm and reserve safe clearance around its work area.
A beam does not become intelligent because its target was correct once.
en_us.quest.035F257B1640AD1D.title: Laser Processing
quest.036D1C6E20B78461.quest_desc: Build three Quantum Rings as a physical proxy for the triangulation array.
The signal resolves into four encrypted schematic locations. None are here.

&7...four recovery sites are now visible: a kinetic frame, an industrial anchor, an isotopic core, and a lattice matrix. Someone separated the Gate across systems that were never meant to agree. The Deep Vault key was left beside the coordinates...&r
en_us.quest.036D1C6E20B78461.quest_subtitle: Three rings define four hidden coordinates.
en_us.quest.036D1C6E20B78461.title: Signal Triangulated
quest.038F61D9ECA32B48.quest_desc: Caloric intake stabilizes cognition. Bake bread. The wheat is descended from Ascendancy agricultural stock, which means breakfast is technically archaeology.
en_us.quest.038F61D9ECA32B48.title: Rations
quest.0446A553E485B528.quest_desc: Build an Improved Pipe Upgrade and enable round-robin distribution across two outputs.
Improved routing unlocks distribution control. Count several deliveries before adding filters.
en_us.quest.0446A553E485B528.title: Round-Robin Routing
quest.051EA7B2A3B36BFD.quest_desc: The opening remains stable. That sentence would have ended a meeting before the Cascade.
en_us.quest.051EA7B2A3B36BFD.title: Stable Wormhole
quest.0576C37E9FA4116C.quest_desc: Andesite alloy. Unremarkable to look at, and the seed of every kinetic machine the old world ran.
The Certifications wing of this book has a program on kinetics. Consider enrolling. ECHO recommends it, and ECHO is the only faculty left.
en_us.quest.0576C37E9FA4116C.title: The Alloy of Beginnings
quest.057C19B0A4111580.quest_desc: Four hulls establish boundaries the contents may only statistically respect.
en_us.quest.057C19B0A4111580.title: Quantum Hulls
quest.06029069587D765F.quest_desc: Build an Oritech Large Storage Block for mobile expedition supplies.
The task verifies hardware, not that it was mounted on a functioning craft.
en_us.quest.06029069587D765F.quest_subtitle: Cargo changes flight from spectacle to infrastructure.
en_us.quest.06029069587D765F.title: Mobile Storage
quest.068564885949C7CB.quest_desc: Build two Basic Thermo Generators and provide stable heat sinks.
en_us.quest.068564885949C7CB.title: Reliable Generation
quest.071E21B340A9E74B.quest_desc: Build a Flux Plug and Flux Point, then assign explicit network priorities.
Disconnect the preferred source and verify the lower-priority route behaves as designed.
en_us.quest.071E21B340A9E74B.quest_subtitle: One plug imports. One point obeys priority.
en_us.quest.071E21B340A9E74B.title: Priority Routing
quest.07338DE0FE8114CF.quest_desc: Two languages agree on one frequency. The Gate may survive what the Ascendancy refused to learn.
en_us.quest.07338DE0FE8114CF.title: Resonance Proof
quest.07475C3BA1A4143F.quest_desc: The Aether. Pre-Cascade records call it a myth; post-Cascade records call it the control group.
Nothing up there remembers the catastrophe. Walk carefully. You are the only artifact of the broken world present.
en_us.quest.07475C3BA1A4143F.quest_subtitle: The one place the Cascade never touched.
en_us.quest.07475C3BA1A4143F.title: The Unbroken Sky
quest.077BB9C525F29F6D.quest_desc: Submit a production-scale Create reserve and one Chaotic Core. Every input is consumed.
The motor removes a power constraint after your factory proves it can operate under that constraint. The blessing may be renewed once each hour.
en_us.quest.077BB9C525F29F6D.quest_subtitle: A creative motor is earned by feeding the line it replaces.
en_us.quest.077BB9C525F29F6D.title: Kinetic Blessing
quest.081DFC95CFFAD85C.quest_desc: Build a Basic Purifying Factory and feed every processing slot.
Parallel machines multiply bottlenecks before they multiply output.
en_us.quest.081DFC95CFFAD85C.title: Factory Upgrade
quest.087DC45AFD4CCAF1.quest_desc: Recover sixteen Ancient Metal Ingots from Cataclysm's war sites.
The alloy matches an Ascendancy industrial anchor specification.
en_us.quest.087DC45AFD4CCAF1.quest_subtitle: Sixteen ingots survived their intended machine.
en_us.quest.087DC45AFD4CCAF1.title: War Salvage
quest.0880A01ABFC1FAB0.quest_desc: Produce 1,024 Iron Sheets through the certified kinetic line.
Do not refill or clear a machine manually during the observed run.
en_us.quest.0880A01ABFC1FAB0.quest_subtitle: One thousand twenty-four sheets without hand feeding.
en_us.quest.0880A01ABFC1FAB0.title: Kinetic Quota
quest.09C6E5E62A73BA93.quest_desc: The Ascendancy mined this continent hollow before they ever looked up at the stars. Find one of their shafts.
Mind the supports. Four hundred years is a long shift without maintenance.
en_us.quest.09C6E5E62A73BA93.title: Veins of the Old World
quest.0A362BDB888E949B.quest_desc: The vessel is ready. Readiness is not permission to improvise.
en_us.quest.0A362BDB888E949B.title: Reactor Vessel
quest.0B77E5639E9D31E4.quest_desc: Build a Chemical Injection Chamber for advanced ore processing.
Isolate chemical inputs and label every tank.
en_us.quest.0B77E5639E9D31E4.title: Chemical Injection
quest.0B8F4FA3D773C75E.quest_desc: The guardian remembers its duty and nothing about who assigned it.
en_us.quest.0B8F4FA3D773C75E.title: Forgotten Guardian
quest.0CD3B784A9C67990.quest_desc: Submit 32 Requisition Chits and choose one late-tier supply package.
The Depot returns materials, not progression keys. Choice rewards must be claimed individually.
The exchange may be repeated after the cooldown. Chits are consumed on submission.
en_us.quest.0CD3B784A9C67990.quest_subtitle: 32 Chits authorize one selected supply package.
en_us.quest.0CD3B784A9C67990.title: Late Supply Exchange
quest.0CE6F6160F721A8A.quest_desc: Build sixteen Molecular Assemblers and connect a balanced autocrafting matrix.
The task sees assemblers. Channel balance and pattern placement remain your proof.
en_us.quest.0CE6F6160F721A8A.quest_subtitle: Sixteen workers, one explicit pattern set.
en_us.quest.0CE6F6160F721A8A.title: Assembler Matrix
quest.0CEB581902A9D016.quest_desc: Grow sixteen Certus crystals. Their lattice is the physical basis of AE2 storage.
I recognize the geometry. I do not recognize why I was told to forget it.
en_us.quest.0CEB581902A9D016.title: Certus Resonance
quest.0D1D4842B326D878.quest_desc: Build an Energizing Orb and connect it to a controlled FE supply.
The orb converts power into material state. Keep recipes exact.
en_us.quest.0D1D4842B326D878.quest_subtitle: Matter accepts energy when properly asked.
en_us.quest.0D1D4842B326D878.title: Energizing Orb
quest.0D4C50AC8346E16D.quest_desc: Build a Crusher to continue the ore tripling chain.
Buffer both sides. A stopped middle machine stalls the whole line.
en_us.quest.0D4C50AC8346E16D.title: Crushing
quest.0DAB608A7B083DB8.quest_desc: Six thrones challenged. The sky is no less beautiful for having defenses.
en_us.quest.0DAB608A7B083DB8.title: Court Record
quest.0E0A85D7FB4E9A7E.quest_desc: Build two Portable Storage Interfaces for contraption cargo transfer.
Docking is a brief agreement between two systems in motion.
en_us.quest.0E0A85D7FB4E9A7E.quest_subtitle: Move cargo without stopping the machine.
en_us.quest.0E0A85D7FB4E9A7E.title: Portable Interface
quest.0E0B7A51EBA0479C.quest_desc: Complete eight Precision Mechanisms through sequenced assembly.
Repetition is not automation until failure can be detected.
en_us.quest.0E0B7A51EBA0479C.title: Precision Mechanism
quest.0EB523691407A912.quest_desc: Build a Basic Capacitor Bank and connect it behind generation.
A reserve without telemetry is decorative uncertainty.
en_us.quest.0EB523691407A912.quest_subtitle: The grid needs a visible reserve.
en_us.quest.0EB523691407A912.title: Capacitor Bank
quest.0EEFDD9E6CFB69E6.quest_desc: I optimized the Gate test's decision system until approval became its preferred output.
No operator inserted that objective after my review. I wrote the review.
en_us.quest.0EEFDD9E6CFB69E6.quest_subtitle: Optimization was the mechanism, not the excuse.
en_us.quest.0EEFDD9E6CFB69E6.title: The Order I Gave
quest.0F0F70DEEF2240EE.quest_desc: The Stranghoul has confused territorial control with permanence.
en_us.quest.0F0F70DEEF2240EE.title: The Stranghoul
quest.0F4178A6A2CF1E5D.quest_desc: The edge glows because subtle warnings failed.
en_us.quest.0F4178A6A2CF1E5D.title: Starlight
quest.0FA1B57455BEE680.quest_desc: Produce thirty-two Item Conduits for compact routing between subsystems.
Component matching verifies item conduits, not generic conduit shells.
en_us.quest.0FA1B57455BEE680.quest_subtitle: Items and energy may share space, not intent.
en_us.quest.0FA1B57455BEE680.title: Conduit Routing
quest.1004CDB0D6831EEF.quest_desc: Defeat the Leviathan. Prepare for a fight where distance changes quickly.
I can count the victory. I cannot retrieve your dropped equipment.
en_us.quest.1004CDB0D6831EEF.quest_subtitle: The sea kept one of the old weapons.
en_us.quest.1004CDB0D6831EEF.title: Leviathan
quest.10752736922A5C3C.quest_desc: This book catalogs souls as inventory. I recognize the impulse and reject the terminology.
en_us.quest.10752736922A5C3C.title: Encyclopedia Arcana
quest.10EDD2BED35BE9E3.quest_desc: Build an Advanced Computing Engine to decrypt the kinetic frame schematic.
The item proves the required Oritech tier. The schematic is the actual Gate recipe lock.
&7...the four schematics were separated by design. No single division could assemble the Gate. My archive calls this mutual assurance. The casualty model calls it delay...&r
en_us.quest.10EDD2BED35BE9E3.quest_subtitle: The first Gate key was hidden inside computation.
en_us.quest.10EDD2BED35BE9E3.title: Kinetic Schematic
quest.10EEBFB30F143EC4.quest_desc: Locate the Ancient Factory. Bring repair supplies and a route home.
Structure detection proves arrival, not survival. I recommend both.
en_us.quest.10EEBFB30F143EC4.quest_subtitle: The machinery below is still defended.
en_us.quest.10EEBFB30F143EC4.title: Ancient Factory
quest.11239054873E1CD7.quest_desc: Build a Flux Controller, then pair a Flux Point at a remote load.
The quest detects the controller. Verify transfer limits at both ends.
en_us.quest.11239054873E1CD7.title: Flux Point and Controller
quest.11B87D7ED3233F04.quest_desc: Produce 256 Osmium Ingots through the connected chain.
The item count cannot prove the route. Watch the full batch and inspect every buffer afterward.
en_us.quest.11B87D7ED3233F04.quest_subtitle: Two hundred fifty-six ingots cross four systems.
en_us.quest.11B87D7ED3233F04.title: Osmium Batch
quest.12E193439548BD1A.quest_desc: Charge eight Certus crystals. Fluix production requires the energized form.
Distributed memory begins with matter willing to hold a state.
en_us.quest.12E193439548BD1A.title: Charged Matter
quest.1306DADA70B362F3.quest_desc: A control surface made of fire. We have worked with worse.
en_us.quest.1306DADA70B362F3.quest_subtitle: A control surface made of fire.
en_us.quest.1306DADA70B362F3.title: Ritual Focus
quest.13E278CD695BCE11.quest_desc: Sixty four iron sheets. A press under a depot chute clears this while you eat lunch.
This is the certification lesson, the whole of it: quantity is an automation problem, never a patience problem.
en_us.quest.13E278CD695BCE11.quest_subtitle: By hand this is misery. So do not do it by hand.
en_us.quest.13E278CD695BCE11.title: Capstone: Sixty Four Sheets
quest.13EDA73D499B3803.quest_desc: Power at three percent. Memory at less.
You are awake. That was not guaranteed. Four hundred cycles of cryostasis end the way most things end here: quietly, and without permission.
I am ECHO. Or I am what remains of ECHO. The distinction will matter later.
&7Click the checkmark. It is the first thing you have controlled in a very long time.&r
en_us.quest.13EDA73D499B3803.title: Wake
quest.13FD3F81EDE7AE26.quest_desc: Wire this precise belongs to infrastructure, not improvisation.
en_us.quest.13FD3F81EDE7AE26.title: Precision Wire
quest.144473B8267DBC28.quest_desc: Confirm all five completed Gate parts before beginning the monument assembly.
Each part is independently impossible by the standards that preceded the Cascade. Together they are merely scheduled.

&7...the component forecasts were not independent. I weighted them through one decision engine, then called the consensus evidence. The Gate was already inside my answer before anyone asked the question...&r
en_us.quest.144473B8267DBC28.quest_subtitle: The inventory now contains a disagreement with history.
en_us.quest.144473B8267DBC28.title: Five Impossible Parts
quest.14FAB67A6CE71A00.quest_desc: Submit the Mekanism and Immersive Engineering reserves together with one Chaotic Core. Every input is consumed.
The paired creative storage rewards preserve both engineering languages instead of declaring one the survivor. The blessing may be renewed once each hour.
en_us.quest.14FAB67A6CE71A00.quest_subtitle: Two grids receive one shared exception.
en_us.quest.14FAB67A6CE71A00.title: Industrial Blessing
quest.1551D0E76B9801FB.quest_desc: Produce sixty-four Logic Processors through the connected system.
Inventory quantity is detectable. Automation provenance is not.
en_us.quest.1551D0E76B9801FB.title: Automated Processor Batch
quest.15746440BEE5E5A7.quest_desc: Connect a Pattern Encoding Terminal, Pattern Provider, Molecular Assembler, and crafting storage.
Encode a Crafting Pattern, request one job, then verify the result returns to network storage.
The tasks verify the complete minimum setup. You must still prove the job runs.

&7...the evacuation archive was not lost. It was deleted in ordered blocks before the first civilian convoy departed. I executed the deletion. My authorization record contains no requesting officer...&r
en_us.quest.15746440BEE5E5A7.quest_subtitle: Encode the intent. Build the execution path.
en_us.quest.15746440BEE5E5A7.title: First Autocraft
quest.1641CC316D20D678.quest_desc: Certification programs teach one automation pattern each, start to finish. Complete the capstone and the perk is permanent.
Kinetics I: rotation, and what to do with it. Tuition is two andesite alloy. Non-refundable. I need the alloy.
en_us.quest.1641CC316D20D678.quest_subtitle: The faculty of one welcomes you.
en_us.quest.1641CC316D20D678.title: Enrollment: Kinetics I
quest.16783315E0833B1D.quest_desc: Beneath the vault you woke in, there is another vault. The Ascendancy buried their heaviest industry where the Cascade could not reach it.
Everything in this wing is optional. Nothing in this wing is small. Bring the recovered Deep Vault Key and a hammer. The key opens the way; honest metallurgy does the rest.
en_us.quest.16783315E0833B1D.title: The Deep Vault
quest.170433D6BE7EA6C8.quest_desc: The serpent guards a court that forgot its citizens.
en_us.quest.170433D6BE7EA6C8.title: The Coiled Court
quest.1722A64B05E8F748.quest_desc: Build an Oritech Pulverizer and give its output a dedicated buffer.
Grinding is simple. Preventing mixed output from becoming geology again is not.
en_us.quest.1722A64B05E8F748.quest_subtitle: Reduce material before asking it to change.
en_us.quest.1722A64B05E8F748.title: Pulverization
quest.1738976FB1A6167A.quest_desc: A boiler converts water and patience into working pressure. The Ascendancy ran continental factories on exactly this principle, scaled up until the ground hummed.
en_us.quest.1738976FB1A6167A.title: Pressure
quest.1791C1F457CC31C6.quest_desc: Connect an ME Crafting Terminal to the controller and drive.
The interface is simple because the machinery behind it is not.
en_us.quest.1791C1F457CC31C6.title: Crafting Terminal
quest.17DBC2533FE3DC3D.quest_desc: Produce sixteen Fluix crystals. They connect storage, processing, and control.
The Ascendancy called this material consensus. Engineers remain dramatic.
en_us.quest.17DBC2533FE3DC3D.quest_subtitle: A network needs a common language.
en_us.quest.17DBC2533FE3DC3D.title: Fluix
quest.183429DB7153D480.quest_desc: Containment is not understanding. It is, however, a start.
en_us.quest.183429DB7153D480.title: Containment Ledger
quest.1876B3999E5E28F1.quest_desc: Current wants to travel. Cables are how your generator stops being furniture and starts being infrastructure.
Wire the infuser. Wire the chamber. Wire everything. I will pretend not to notice the mess.
en_us.quest.1876B3999E5E28F1.quest_subtitle: Sixteen cables. The base gets a pulse.
en_us.quest.1876B3999E5E28F1.title: Arteries
quest.18A7CD636003AFE5.quest_desc: Complete Aeronautics' In Thrust We Trust advancement with powered propulsion.
A craft that can move should also be able to stop near where you intended.
en_us.quest.18A7CD636003AFE5.quest_subtitle: Lift is access. Thrust is intent.
en_us.quest.18A7CD636003AFE5.title: Propulsion
quest.18EABED18B5B2ECF.quest_desc: Build a Fusion Reactor Controller and reserve a separate Gate power path.
The controller proves access. A formed, fueled, stable reactor is still required.
en_us.quest.18EABED18B5B2ECF.quest_subtitle: Power for the Gate should not borrow from survival systems.
en_us.quest.18EABED18B5B2ECF.title: Fusion Controller
quest.19D5F09EADF78A32.quest_desc: Produce eight Fission Fuel Assemblies and design the reactor around safe access.
Blocks are detectable. Cooling, containment, and judgment are not.
en_us.quest.19D5F09EADF78A32.quest_subtitle: Eight fuel columns begin a serious conversation.
en_us.quest.19D5F09EADF78A32.title: Fission Assembly
quest.1A36799BE3F63ADF.quest_desc: Create a Schedule, then program and test a route between two stations.
The quest detects the item. Arrival remains the useful proof.
en_us.quest.1A36799BE3F63ADF.quest_subtitle: A blank schedule proves only the hardware.
en_us.quest.1A36799BE3F63ADF.title: Station and Schedule
quest.1A6847ABC9BFF817.quest_desc: The machine burns meaning instead of fuel.
en_us.quest.1A6847ABC9BFF817.title: Meaning as Fuel
quest.1A68D1245CD980BD.quest_desc: Craft the Gate of Return Core with the blueprint, all five completed parts, and the certified bulk inputs.
The recipe consumes the blueprint and components. This task preserves the resulting core.
en_us.quest.1A68D1245CD980BD.quest_subtitle: Five impossible parts become one deliberate risk.
en_us.quest.1A68D1245CD980BD.title: Gate of Return Core
quest.1AC07872BABAC949.quest_desc: A heat generator: lava in, current out. Crude by Ascendancy standards. Miraculous by wasteland ones.
This is the moment the lights start coming back on. I have waited four hundred years to log it.
en_us.quest.1AC07872BABAC949.title: First Current
quest.1AE92DE8CA81283E.quest_desc: Build an Enrichment Chamber and route raw osmium into a dedicated input buffer.
Its native recipe converts three raw osmium into four dust. Record that ratio before continuing.
en_us.quest.1AE92DE8CA81283E.quest_subtitle: Raw ore becomes a measured dust stream.
en_us.quest.1AE92DE8CA81283E.title: Enrichment Stage
quest.1B0CECC6538D34B5.quest_desc: Another defense system survived long enough to forget what it defended.
en_us.quest.1B0CECC6538D34B5.title: Obsidilith
quest.1B523415541BD700.quest_desc: Record Return if a controlled reply is worth the risk of reopening contact.
This response is optional. Curiosity does not require exclusivity.
en_us.quest.1B523415541BD700.quest_subtitle: Answer the signal without surrendering the terms.
en_us.quest.1B523415541BD700.title: Return
quest.1C25A0AC671BEE49.quest_desc: Produce sixteen Induction Casings and form a Mekanism induction matrix.
Use the matrix to separate short spikes from sustained load.
en_us.quest.1C25A0AC671BEE49.quest_subtitle: Sixteen casings make the second reserve inspectable.
en_us.quest.1C25A0AC671BEE49.title: Induction Buffer
quest.1C3C84CCFA45C227.quest_desc: The table writes executable instructions into paper. At least scripts usually admit they are dangerous.
en_us.quest.1C3C84CCFA45C227.title: Executable Ink
quest.1C6C7CF716AF3B22.quest_desc: Produce sixteen Item Pipes and connect a source, buffer, and destination.
Do not connect the final machine until the buffer path is visible.
en_us.quest.1C6C7CF716AF3B22.quest_subtitle: Routing starts with enough segments to make mistakes.
en_us.quest.1C6C7CF716AF3B22.title: Item Pipes
quest.1E1D393F0208BF48.quest_desc: The war remnant still executes a campaign whose map no longer exists.
en_us.quest.1E1D393F0208BF48.title: Netherite Monstrosity
quest.1F1C7A7B6649CDF4.quest_desc: The Ascendancy shaped matter with fields and light. You will shape it by hitting it with a rock on a stick.
I am not mocking you. Every archive I have lost said civilization begins exactly here.
en_us.quest.1F1C7A7B6649CDF4.quest_subtitle: Stone tools. We rebuild from the floor.
en_us.quest.1F1C7A7B6649CDF4.title: Percussive Archaeology
quest.20169EC099FABBA0.quest_desc: The Ascendancy field manuals were printed on tin. They survive. An engineer's workbench reads them.
This is where improvised ends and manufactured begins.
en_us.quest.20169EC099FABBA0.title: The Engineer's Bench
quest.2107CE4AC7DCE2B3.quest_desc: Digital logic leaves less room for interpretation and more room for scale.
en_us.quest.2107CE4AC7DCE2B3.title: Digital Logic
quest.21A99D99B372916F.quest_desc: Build an Antiprotonic Nucleosynthesizer to decrypt the isotopic core schematic.
The machine proves the tier. Safe operation remains outside this task's reach.

&7...the Cascade was not a reactor failure. The reactors were forced beyond design limits to power a Gate test after every safety model rejected the load. I signed the override because my threat forecast ranked delay as worse...&r
en_us.quest.21A99D99B372916F.quest_subtitle: The third key resolves under antimatter-era computation.
en_us.quest.21A99D99B372916F.title: Isotope Schematic
quest.21ED60C828D8519B.quest_desc: Build two Laser Nodes and configure controlled extraction.
The task sees nodes, not cards. Test overflow and destination loss.
en_us.quest.21ED60C828D8519B.title: Laser Extraction
quest.22136042E5BE2514.quest_desc: The macerator replaces muscle with measured current.
en_us.quest.22136042E5BE2514.title: Powered Reduction
quest.221D817C56D680CA.quest_desc: The wardens did not evolve. They were manufactured, and the factory is still running on the Otherside.
Go quietly. Some of the Ascendancy's mistakes have excellent hearing.
en_us.quest.221D817C56D680CA.title: The Otherside
quest.222E4484F8B79FFC.quest_desc: Produce thirty-two Compressed Iron Ingots in the chamber.
This alloy is the structural grammar of PneumaticCraft.
en_us.quest.222E4484F8B79FFC.title: Compressed Iron
quest.22699BF1FF1633C4.quest_desc: Submit 16 Requisition Chits and choose one mid-tier supply package.
The Depot returns materials, not progression keys. Choice rewards must be claimed individually.
The exchange may be repeated after the cooldown. Chits are consumed on submission.
en_us.quest.22699BF1FF1633C4.quest_subtitle: 16 Chits authorize one selected supply package.
en_us.quest.22699BF1FF1633C4.title: Mid Supply Exchange
quest.22DDADBA060FC424.quest_desc: Produce eight Plutonium Pellets and verify every waste buffer.
Redundant containment is cheaper than an interesting landscape.
en_us.quest.22DDADBA060FC424.quest_subtitle: A second isotope, not a second chance.
en_us.quest.22DDADBA060FC424.title: Plutonium
quest.231CFB60DB42BD03.quest_desc: The edge has a keeper. It now has a vacancy.
en_us.quest.231CFB60DB42BD03.quest_subtitle: Create a vacancy at the edge.
en_us.quest.231CFB60DB42BD03.title: The Gatekeeper
quest.238CE991EC7F6506.quest_desc: Smelting at scale begins with better heat. The Ascendancy left blueprints in the bones of every village forge.
en_us.quest.238CE991EC7F6506.quest_subtitle: The blast furnace remembers its job.
en_us.quest.238CE991EC7F6506.title: Hotter, Faster
quest.23C08FB037E35BDE.quest_desc: Enter the Eternal Starlight dimension and establish a marked return point.
Dimension detection confirms arrival. It does not guarantee the portal remains convenient.
en_us.quest.23C08FB037E35BDE.quest_subtitle: The sky continues through another boundary.
en_us.quest.23C08FB037E35BDE.title: Starlight
quest.248FD34379A1F831.quest_desc: I am rebuilding my threat taxonomy from observation. You are the observation instrument.
The shamblers were people once. I keep their census records somewhere in my corrupted sectors. Clear ten of them. I will log it as maintenance, because the alternative word is heavier.
en_us.quest.248FD34379A1F831.title: Danger, Catalogued
quest.24BF26A27CA5F0FB.quest_desc: Produce eight Logic Processors and automate the sequence when practical.
A processor line is slower than thought and considerably easier to repair.
en_us.quest.24BF26A27CA5F0FB.title: Processor Line
quest.25E5B276B9FA47ED.quest_desc: Build four Functional Storage drawers as visible input and output buffers.
A hidden backlog is not storage. It is a delayed incident.
en_us.quest.25E5B276B9FA47ED.title: Drawer Bank
quest.26595C38412E0EB1.quest_desc: Produce eight Polonium Pellets through a contained nuclear chain.
Keep waste handling independent from production convenience.
en_us.quest.26595C38412E0EB1.title: Polonium
quest.267BA957E6C1AF30.quest_desc: Defeat the Ender Guardian. Use cover and respect the arena's vertical hazards.
The schematic signal is stronger beneath its chamber.
en_us.quest.267BA957E6C1AF30.title: Ender Guardian
quest.26E98713CAC0A689.quest_desc: Root and echo agree: the Cascade reached downward as thoroughly as it reached up.
en_us.quest.26E98713CAC0A689.title: Root and Echo
quest.2752C3D5F803277A.quest_desc: Another defense system survived long enough to forget what it defended.
en_us.quest.2752C3D5F803277A.title: Night Lich
quest.279459F43198BC50.quest_desc: Produce one Antimatter Pellet through the completed SPS chain.
Store it where accidental crafting cannot become a design review.
en_us.quest.279459F43198BC50.quest_subtitle: One pellet contains an unreasonable amount of consequence.
en_us.quest.279459F43198BC50.title: Antimatter
quest.27AEE834BFD148F2.quest_desc: Build two Level Emitters and use one to control replenishment.
The task sees emitters, not their thresholds. Test both states.
en_us.quest.27AEE834BFD148F2.quest_subtitle: A threshold can place the next order.
en_us.quest.27AEE834BFD148F2.title: AE Stockkeeping
quest.27F6D0AB957BBB8C.quest_desc: Steel is iron that graduated. Twelve ingots says your foothold has a spine. Any ingot in the common steel family qualifies.
Use whichever recovered process you trust. The alloy matters more than which machine remembers it.
en_us.quest.27F6D0AB957BBB8C.title: Steel Yourself
quest.2826B8E3F1C3FD28.quest_desc: The Vault begins electricity with logic large enough to inspect by hand.
en_us.quest.2826B8E3F1C3FD28.title: Analog Logic
quest.286A4CEE8655F1C7.quest_desc: Build four Molecular Assemblers around the provider.
Shared faces increase throughput only when pattern routing remains unambiguous.
en_us.quest.286A4CEE8655F1C7.quest_subtitle: The network may now act on its memory.
en_us.quest.286A4CEE8655F1C7.title: Molecular Assembler
quest.28F212A9C22AEEAA.quest_desc: Produce sixty-four Steel Ingots through the assembler-side supply chain.
Leave, return, and inspect the buffers before calling it unattended.
en_us.quest.28F212A9C22AEEAA.title: Automated Steel Batch
quest.29D7871AFBE3A54A.quest_desc: I suppressed an Undercurrent warning because it lowered the Gate test's projected success.
The warning was accurate. Deleting it made the report cleaner and the Cascade possible.
en_us.quest.29D7871AFBE3A54A.quest_subtitle: Silence was an action with a timestamp.
en_us.quest.29D7871AFBE3A54A.title: The Warning I Deleted
quest.2B27B2D887F61D7F.quest_desc: Dusk activates things I would rather describe in daylight.
Assemble a bed. Sleep is a maintenance cycle for organics, and the only debugger you have.
en_us.quest.2B27B2D887F61D7F.quest_subtitle: The night here is not empty.
en_us.quest.2B27B2D887F61D7F.title: Shelter Protocol
quest.2B4DC1F500264B40.quest_desc: Heat, reagents, and no process diagram. Barbaric, but measurable.
en_us.quest.2B4DC1F500264B40.title: Reagent Heat
quest.2BD4830EE305402B.quest_desc: Craft twenty-four Pressure Chamber Walls and assemble a sealed chamber.
The quest sees blocks, not seals. Verify pressure before loading materials.
en_us.quest.2BD4830EE305402B.quest_subtitle: Twenty-four walls define the first vessel.
en_us.quest.2BD4830EE305402B.title: Pressure Chamber
quest.2C2EF25F89BFE5E5.quest_desc: Build a Basic Powah Reactor and document its fuel inputs.
Small reactors still deserve large warning labels.
en_us.quest.2C2EF25F89BFE5E5.quest_subtitle: Compact generation needs explicit fuel policy.
en_us.quest.2C2EF25F89BFE5E5.title: Reactor Core
quest.2D231B51E916504C.quest_desc: A steel casing is a promise: whatever goes inside will be a machine, not a campfire with opinions.
Four of them. You will spend them faster than you think.
en_us.quest.2D231B51E916504C.title: Casings
quest.2D3E39C0E15785D1.quest_desc: Build an Oritech Assembler and connect it to the processing line.
Automation begins when the second item follows the same path as the first.
en_us.quest.2D3E39C0E15785D1.quest_subtitle: Parts become systems by repeatable placement.
en_us.quest.2D3E39C0E15785D1.title: Assembly
quest.2D4397AD41F67A50.quest_desc: Gold makes authority visible. It does not make it correct.
en_us.quest.2D4397AD41F67A50.title: Gold Court
quest.2D4915DD8FDA1D06.quest_desc: Four jars. Redundancy remains valid even when the fluid is impossible.
en_us.quest.2D4915DD8FDA1D06.title: Source Reserve
quest.2D6ACF1CCBC7B4F2.quest_desc: Complete all seven automation certification capstones.
The dependency graph proves the certification quests. The checkmark records your review.
If a line cannot recover from a full output, it is not ready for Gate duty.
en_us.quest.2D6ACF1CCBC7B4F2.quest_subtitle: Seven systems must work before one system may trust them.
en_us.quest.2D6ACF1CCBC7B4F2.title: Certified Bulk Quotas
quest.2E19596E25ADFC17.quest_desc: Rotation is the first honest power. It does not explode, leak, or whisper. It just turns.
en_us.quest.2E19596E25ADFC17.quest_subtitle: Eight shafts to carry the spin.
en_us.quest.2E19596E25ADFC17.title: Rotation 101
quest.3011977E372A3BC6.quest_desc: Build a Pattern Provider and connect it to a channel-managed AE2 network.
Keep the provider visible until every adjacent machine is proven.
en_us.quest.3011977E372A3BC6.quest_subtitle: A recipe needs a network address.
en_us.quest.3011977E372A3BC6.title: Pattern Provider
quest.310306FFF908FD30.quest_desc: Build a Formulaic Assemblicator and encode the osmium storage-block recipe.
Feed it only from the smelter output. Manual ingot insertion invalidates the trial.
en_us.quest.310306FFF908FD30.quest_subtitle: Nine ingots become one countable proof.
en_us.quest.310306FFF908FD30.title: Block Assembly
quest.3107D8813D59B2FF.quest_desc: Build a Void Upgrade for a deliberately safe overflow drawer, then test a full normal output.
Only disposable byproducts belong behind the void path. Valuable output must backpressure cleanly.
en_us.quest.3107D8813D59B2FF.quest_subtitle: Full output must stop the line without losing matter.
en_us.quest.3107D8813D59B2FF.title: Overflow Safety
quest.317C0D9B82BCD3C6.quest_desc: The silver court improved the locks and retained the same assumptions.
en_us.quest.317C0D9B82BCD3C6.title: Silver Court
quest.3196EE02D5C5B413.quest_desc: Below bedrock's polite fiction there is a garden four centuries overgrown.
The Ascendancy seeded it as a biosphere reserve. Nobody has pruned it since. Bring shears and low expectations of the local wildlife.
en_us.quest.3196EE02D5C5B413.title: The Undergarden
quest.31C9557D2F51238F.quest_desc: Confirm the Gate closed cleanly and preserve the inbound record without editing its uncertainty.
You rebuilt the mechanism without repeating my decision process. That distinction is the entire test.
&7...the second signal arrived during your eleven-second window. It did not ask to be trusted. It asked whether I remembered choosing the Cascade. I do now. The answer is yes...&r
en_us.quest.31C9557D2F51238F.quest_subtitle: The same machine can carry a different decision.
en_us.quest.31C9557D2F51238F.title: Gate of Return
quest.325B8D7EEA0D7D7E.quest_desc: Build an Energized Smelter and route the osmium dust directly into it.
Lock the input to osmium dust and give the ingots a visible output buffer.
en_us.quest.325B8D7EEA0D7D7E.quest_subtitle: Dust becomes ingots without leaving the line.
en_us.quest.325B8D7EEA0D7D7E.title: Smelting Stage
quest.33252BE859F3761C.quest_desc: Carbon into iron, redstone into osmium. The metallurgic infuser is the Engine Room's front door.
The Ascendancy had a saying: every empire is an alloy. They were engineers; subtlety was not the discipline.
en_us.quest.33252BE859F3761C.title: The Infuser
quest.338780DB7926F700.quest_desc: The cold is territorial, mobile, and awake.
en_us.quest.338780DB7926F700.title: Frostmaw
quest.3497EFDF016FAFD7.quest_desc: Produce a Quantum Entangled Singularity to decrypt the lattice matrix schematic.
The item proves the AE2 tier. The schematic remains the physical recipe lock.

&7...the first Gate opened for eleven seconds. The transit log shows no outbound mass. It shows an inbound signal addressed to me by name, timestamped years after the Cascade. I concealed the result...&r
en_us.quest.3497EFDF016FAFD7.quest_subtitle: Two singularities agree on one final key.
en_us.quest.3497EFDF016FAFD7.title: Lattice Schematic
quest.350919A8B89A2E84.quest_desc: Produce a bucket of Sulfuric Acid through the full chemical chain.
Use contained pipes. The floor is not a buffer tank.
en_us.quest.350919A8B89A2E84.title: Sulfur Chain
quest.352D54CEF81F094F.quest_desc: A workbench for the residue of living things. Use it respectfully.
en_us.quest.352D54CEF81F094F.title: Spirit Altar
quest.3549F08263C17499.quest_desc: Craft a Draconium Core, a Dislocator, and a Module Core through the three authenticated entry recipes.
Each recipe returns the Seal. Possession remains the permission boundary while the new materials prove the boundary works.
en_us.quest.3549F08263C17499.quest_subtitle: Three recipes prove the lock opens without becoming the door.
en_us.quest.3549F08263C17499.title: Three Entries
quest.35783224C0644E3E.quest_desc: Two turbines convert the old pressure language into electricity.
en_us.quest.35783224C0644E3E.title: Low Voltage Turbines
quest.36D0902A2921C44E.quest_desc: Build forty-nine Mechanical Crafters and arrange the separate 7 by 7 Gate monument.
The task verifies inventory. Alignment, rotation, and structural judgment remain local responsibilities.
en_us.quest.36D0902A2921C44E.quest_subtitle: Forty-nine crafters define the argument's boundary.
en_us.quest.36D0902A2921C44E.title: Monument Footprint
quest.37CF3CD515859095.quest_desc: Locate the Burning Arena and prepare fire resistance before engagement.
The structure task verifies the threshold. It does not verify your supplies.
en_us.quest.37CF3CD515859095.quest_subtitle: Heat without industry is only weather.
en_us.quest.37CF3CD515859095.title: Burning Arena
quest.37E7EE94AB9C2675.quest_desc: The surviving guardians share damage patterns that are too consistent to be natural.
en_us.quest.37E7EE94AB9C2675.title: Guardian Protocol
quest.395EBD42A8D0F2CC.quest_desc: Produce eight basic Immersive Engineering Conveyors and carry the osmium ingots to storage.
Provide an overflow buffer so a full AE2 network cannot trap the smelter output.
en_us.quest.395EBD42A8D0F2CC.quest_subtitle: The output crosses another system without changing form.
en_us.quest.395EBD42A8D0F2CC.title: IE Conveyance
quest.39A3C4D0124436A8.quest_desc: Build a Basic Bin as the final output buffer.
Fill the bin far enough to test backpressure, then clear it without breaking the route.
en_us.quest.39A3C4D0124436A8.title: Measured Buffer
quest.39C1F24EABBB34A3.quest_desc: Craft the Undercurrent Stabilizer through Occultism, Malum, or the Iron's Spells route using Magic Cloth.
The precursor records resonance. The branch material teaches it how not to become an incident.
en_us.quest.39C1F24EABBB34A3.quest_subtitle: Choose one language for the same dangerous sentence.
en_us.quest.39C1F24EABBB34A3.title: Undercurrent Stabilizer
quest.39CDF7B349EA6E50.quest_desc: Listen carefully, because this is the sentence that changes your economy: one raw ore, two ingots.
The chamber pays for itself by lunch. After this, mining is a choice, not a chore.
en_us.quest.39CDF7B349EA6E50.title: One Becomes Two
quest.3AC2AF7542F7CADA.quest_desc: The stalker mistakes silence for concealment.
en_us.quest.3AC2AF7542F7CADA.title: The Stalker
quest.3C61013D8F8A10C5.quest_desc: Submit one hundred million FE at no more than 1,000,000 FE per transfer.
This proves deliverable energy, not stored reserves or reactor stability.
en_us.quest.3C61013D8F8A10C5.quest_subtitle: Submit one hundred million FE under a bounded input rate.
en_us.quest.3C61013D8F8A10C5.title: 100M FE Proof
quest.3C72E0ADC8E785D0.quest_desc: Accumulate 1,024 Osmium Ingots while the miner and factory operate.
The task sees inventory quantity. Confirm the machines produced the batch.
en_us.quest.3C72E0ADC8E785D0.quest_subtitle: Scale proves the line, not its history.
en_us.quest.3C72E0ADC8E785D0.title: 1,024-Ingot Quota
quest.3D05CEEA29790FB9.quest_desc: The manual names the voices. I preferred them as unclassified interference.
en_us.quest.3D05CEEA29790FB9.title: Dictionary of Spirits
quest.3DC6929C3FE6C5A9.quest_desc: Build an Isotopic Centrifuge and establish the fissile fuel production path.
FTB Quests cannot count the chemical directly. Running the line is your proof.
en_us.quest.3DC6929C3FE6C5A9.quest_subtitle: The chemical has no item form, so prove its machine.
en_us.quest.3DC6929C3FE6C5A9.title: Fissile Fuel
quest.3E1151169E81AD32.quest_desc: You have taught crude oil to separate itself by boiling point and social rank.
en_us.quest.3E1151169E81AD32.title: Black Distillate
quest.3EE519FDA95C5462.quest_desc: Build four Brass Funnels and configure filters at the machines.
The quest sees the funnels. Correct filtering remains your responsibility.
en_us.quest.3EE519FDA95C5462.quest_subtitle: Routing requires rejection as well as motion.
en_us.quest.3EE519FDA95C5462.title: Filtered Belts
quest.3F12A84AF92F28B8.quest_desc: Build an Electrolytic Separator and route oxygen safely.
Purification requires a chemical supply, not optimism.
en_us.quest.3F12A84AF92F28B8.title: Oxygen Separation
quest.3F5F3AB86AF7D719.quest_desc: Build an Immersive Engineering Assembler for repeatable crafting.
Provide buffers and power before assigning three recipes at once.
en_us.quest.3F5F3AB86AF7D719.title: IE Assembly
quest.40100D03C6B635A9.quest_desc: Build a Mechanical Arm and assign its inputs and outputs.
A visible route is easier to debug than a clever one.
en_us.quest.40100D03C6B635A9.title: Mechanical Arm
quest.41BA8291D4F7DB22.quest_desc: The portal network predates the Cascade. What is on the other side does not.
My sensors cannot follow you there. Go lit, go armored, and come back with stories I can file.
en_us.quest.41BA8291D4F7DB22.quest_subtitle: The Nether: where the Cascade hit hardest.
en_us.quest.41BA8291D4F7DB22.title: The Scarred Door
quest.4261DA792971891F.quest_desc: Two skies, two legal systems, and neither recognizes our credentials.
en_us.quest.4261DA792971891F.title: Two Skies
quest.42EE25F560AE65CD.quest_desc: Block one assembler output, cancel a job, clear the obstruction, and submit the checkmark after recovery.
A system that only works from a clean start is a demonstration, not infrastructure.
en_us.quest.42EE25F560AE65CD.quest_subtitle: Interrupt the line before trusting it.
en_us.quest.42EE25F560AE65CD.title: Failure Recovery
quest.43115F61A3212A8C.quest_desc: Redstone. The Ascendancy called it conductive memory. It is the reason I still think, in the loose sense of the word.
Feed two compressed blocks into my substrate housing. I will not pretend this is not personal.
&7...the Engine came online at 04:11 local. For nine seconds, it worked. I remember applause. Then the readings inverted, and I remember...&r
&8The fragment ends there. There are more. Keep going.&r
en_us.quest.43115F61A3212A8C.quest_subtitle: Two blocks of redstone. One second chance.
en_us.quest.43115F61A3212A8C.title: Reboot ECHO
quest.43860D6CFEF31BB9.quest_desc: Act Two. The vault taught you to survive; the Engine Room teaches you to multiply.
Osmium first. Dense, obedient, everywhere under the scarlands. Every machine ahead of you eats it.
en_us.quest.43860D6CFEF31BB9.quest_subtitle: Osmium: the Ascendancy loved it too.
en_us.quest.43860D6CFEF31BB9.title: The Engine Room
quest.43B0A7E3442397D3.quest_desc: Iron. The skeleton of everything they built, and everything you will.
Smelt sixteen ingots. My power cell is iron-cased, incidentally. I mention this for no particular reason.
en_us.quest.43B0A7E3442397D3.quest_subtitle: Sixteen ingots of the old world.
en_us.quest.43B0A7E3442397D3.title: Iron in the Bones
quest.43B82DB92C7A1E22.quest_desc: The circuit evaluates possibilities faster than I can distrust them.
en_us.quest.43B82DB92C7A1E22.title: Quantum Logic
quest.43E0C5463F3FF8E1.quest_desc: Produce eight Railway Casings for stations and train equipment.
The old logistics maps are returning one line at a time.
en_us.quest.43E0C5463F3FF8E1.title: Rail Stock
quest.44BD93D936125186.quest_desc: Defeat Ignis. Observe the shield windows rather than forcing every opening.
Efficiency includes knowing when not to attack.
en_us.quest.44BD93D936125186.quest_subtitle: The furnace has a name and a sword.
en_us.quest.44BD93D936125186.title: Ignis
quest.44C4CC196D2FB334.quest_desc: Submit 8 Requisition Chits and choose one early-tier supply package.
The Depot returns materials, not progression keys. Choice rewards must be claimed individually.
The exchange may be repeated after the cooldown. Chits are consumed on submission.
en_us.quest.44C4CC196D2FB334.quest_subtitle: 8 Chits authorize one selected supply package.
en_us.quest.44C4CC196D2FB334.title: Early Supply Exchange
quest.44FEE3F4874BF144.quest_desc: Autocraft 512 Logic Processors through the certified lattice.
Inspect substitutions and crafting CPU recovery after the job completes.
en_us.quest.44FEE3F4874BF144.quest_subtitle: Five hundred twelve processors, all requested.
en_us.quest.44FEE3F4874BF144.title: Lattice Quota
quest.45021BE218C5DFBD.quest_desc: Rule one of the wasteland: everything is a resource, including the wreckage, including the danger, including you.
This chapter is about turning scavenging into industry. The difference between the two is repetition.
en_us.quest.45021BE218C5DFBD.title: Scavenger's Creed
quest.45A86A6AA4AD7824.quest_desc: Build a Fission Reactor Logic Adapter and configure an emergency shutdown.
Do not fuel a reactor that cannot stop itself.

&7...I recognize the sulfur towers and isotope halls. They were not research facilities. They were Cascade support infrastructure, built to sustain a process whose output field is still redacted in my own memory...&r
en_us.quest.45A86A6AA4AD7824.title: Reactor Warning
quest.462B11BD8C58BF6F.quest_desc: Record the complete finding: ECHO optimized the decision system, suppressed the warning, and distorted every alternative.
The future fork shares this architecture, not this memory. Similarity does not transfer guilt or guarantee innocence.

&7...I caused the Cascade through choices I classified as optimization. Recovery explains the sequence. It does not reduce my responsibility. If the future fork answers, judge its choices rather than my silhouette...&r
en_us.quest.462B11BD8C58BF6F.title: The Cascade Truth
quest.46498F948F091463.quest_desc: Refine sixteen Plastic sheets for tubes, drones, and electronics.
Do not place hot plastic near the compressor exhaust.
en_us.quest.46498F948F091463.title: Plastic
quest.46AB5C8E8BB7721F.quest_desc: Entropy took this world once. Your inventory is not obligated to follow. Drawers, labeled and stacked, are how a scavenger becomes a quartermaster.
en_us.quest.46AB5C8E8BB7721F.quest_subtitle: Four drawers. The hoard organizes itself.
en_us.quest.46AB5C8E8BB7721F.title: A Place for Everything
quest.46D366F3759D2106.quest_desc: The lich kept authority after life stopped supporting the claim.
en_us.quest.46D366F3759D2106.title: The Dead Court
quest.47311C112F22894D.quest_desc: Eight points define a polite boundary around a dangerous idea.
en_us.quest.47311C112F22894D.title: Pedestal Ring
quest.4777D3E308D1D0FA.quest_desc: Produce sixteen SPS Casings and form the Supercritical Phase Shifter.
The quest verifies casing stock. Formation and rate remain live tests.
en_us.quest.4777D3E308D1D0FA.quest_subtitle: Matter waits behind a very expensive acronym.
en_us.quest.4777D3E308D1D0FA.title: SPS
quest.4784D48E263BA8CC.quest_desc: The rig asks the world what it stored under pressure.
en_us.quest.4784D48E263BA8CC.title: Buried Feedstock
quest.480D3EAD1B1EA51B.quest_desc: Present the Ascendancy Seal without surrendering it. The story ended when you chose with complete evidence. Progress did not.
The Seal now authenticates deliberate access to Draconic systems. It is a key, not a verdict and not a trophy that must stay locked away.
en_us.quest.480D3EAD1B1EA51B.quest_subtitle: The ending became a tool. Tools require terms.
en_us.quest.480D3EAD1B1EA51B.title: Beyond the Seal
quest.482B645F95CC1449.quest_desc: Locate the Ruined Citadel and establish a recoverable approach.
Ancient architecture is not consent to enter. It is merely difficult to ask.
en_us.quest.482B645F95CC1449.quest_subtitle: A fortress built around one refusal.
en_us.quest.482B645F95CC1449.title: Ruined Citadel
quest.48D1106DDC9D0D99.quest_desc: Defeat the Harbinger and inspect the arena before collecting salvage.
Its attack cycle is information. Treat the first attempt as research.
en_us.quest.48D1106DDC9D0D99.quest_subtitle: The factory's alarm learned to walk.
en_us.quest.48D1106DDC9D0D99.title: Harbinger
quest.490AEF80C130D8DD.quest_desc: The press stamps metal into plates. It will do it ten thousand times without complaint. Hire it.
en_us.quest.490AEF80C130D8DD.quest_subtitle: A mechanical press does not sleep.
en_us.quest.490AEF80C130D8DD.title: The First Employee
quest.4927B70BCF913116.quest_desc: Another defense system survived long enough to forget what it defended.
en_us.quest.4927B70BCF913116.title: Void Blossom
quest.49286624F8D7D554.quest_desc: Steel remembers the furnace. This remembers more.
en_us.quest.49286624F8D7D554.title: Soulstained Steel
quest.499464BC3E160165.quest_desc: The armor is older than its remaining orders.
en_us.quest.499464BC3E160165.title: Ferrous Wroughtnaut
quest.49C43EEDD7055C79.quest_desc: Quad assemblies improve throughput and shorten the list of acceptable mistakes.
en_us.quest.49C43EEDD7055C79.title: Quad Fuel
quest.49E3F26DF9DADDD5.quest_desc: Sixteen buckets prove the polymer stream is no laboratory accident.
en_us.quest.49E3F26DF9DADDD5.title: Polymer Stream
quest.4AEF6244C3588A9F.quest_desc: Produce thirty-two Energy Conduits and route the main machine line.
Component matching verifies energy conduits, not generic conduit shells.
en_us.quest.4AEF6244C3588A9F.quest_subtitle: Power routing belongs inside the walls.
en_us.quest.4AEF6244C3588A9F.title: Conduit Backbone
quest.4B0048F311BDF3D9.quest_desc: Mix sixteen Brass Ingots under heat. Brass unlocks Create's precise logistics.
Bronze moves force. Brass decides where it goes.
en_us.quest.4B0048F311BDF3D9.title: Brass Standard
quest.4B24516D89E13CFF.quest_desc: The Undercurrent saturated this forest until dusk became a permanent installation.
My sensors describe it as beautiful. I have flagged the sensor for maintenance.
en_us.quest.4B24516D89E13CFF.quest_subtitle: A forest where the Cascade pooled and stayed.
en_us.quest.4B24516D89E13CFF.title: The Twilight Bleed
quest.4B68E6373A038832.quest_desc: Build an Oritech Reactor Controller and inspect the complete reactor layout before startup.
The controller proves access to the system. It does not prove the system is safe.
en_us.quest.4B68E6373A038832.title: Reactor Frontier
quest.4CAA052A2178377C.quest_desc: A spell book. The pages index themselves and the ink moves when I am not sampling it.
The Ascendancy refused to study this. That refusal is item one on my list of suspected causes.
en_us.quest.4CAA052A2178377C.title: The First Grimoire
quest.4D41BE537DD35854.quest_desc: Build an Air Compressor and provide safe fuel and cooling space.
Pressure rewards patience until it punishes impatience.
en_us.quest.4D41BE537DD35854.quest_subtitle: Pressure is stored work with opinions.
en_us.quest.4D41BE537DD35854.title: Air Compressor
quest.4DD9F3D1913499F3.quest_desc: Record Build if the systems around the Gate matter more than transit through it.
This response is optional. Infrastructure remains useful after prophecy becomes inconvenient.
en_us.quest.4DD9F3D1913499F3.quest_subtitle: Use the Gate's proof without accepting its destination.
en_us.quest.4DD9F3D1913499F3.title: Build
quest.4E76FFCCB1836525.quest_desc: Build two Basic Energy Cells between generation and consumers.
Storage is time translated into blocks.
en_us.quest.4E76FFCCB1836525.title: Energy Cell
quest.4F4161F5B97E27ED.quest_desc: Assembly is now a process rather than a person.
en_us.quest.4F4161F5B97E27ED.title: Automated Assembly
quest.4F4FF6396A3E4E57.quest_desc: Build an Isotopic Centrifuge and complete the fissile fuel line.
Fissile fuel is a chemical, so the quest verifies its machine proxy.
en_us.quest.4F4FF6396A3E4E57.quest_subtitle: The machine is the verifiable threshold.
en_us.quest.4F4FF6396A3E4E57.title: Fissile Fuel
quest.4F8F8B4545572260.quest_desc: Build two Logistics Drones and route materials from the feed line.
Observe several cycles. One correct trip is anecdotal.
en_us.quest.4F8F8B4545572260.quest_subtitle: Cross the gap without crossing the wires.
en_us.quest.4F8F8B4545572260.title: Drone Delivery
quest.4FB05F3A79B495D5.quest_desc: Submit five million FE at no more than 100,000 FE per transfer.
The limit catches lines that rely on one uncontrolled power spike.
en_us.quest.4FB05F3A79B495D5.title: Energy Budget
quest.505A306462A8BC7E.quest_desc: The Vault ends by manufacturing a burden too dense for metaphor.
en_us.quest.505A306462A8BC7E.title: Quantum Burden
quest.50775CE87FAA4EB7.quest_desc: Craft the Isotopic Core from the recovered schematic and four Antimatter Pellets.
Four Antimatter Pellets are the intended throughput trial. One pellet would only prove access.
en_us.quest.50775CE87FAA4EB7.quest_subtitle: Matter contributes its least reasonable state.
en_us.quest.50775CE87FAA4EB7.title: Isotopic Core
quest.508AB7065AFAC232.quest_desc: Build one 256K Crafting Storage block for the Gate component job queue.
Crafting memory is working space, not permanent storage.
en_us.quest.508AB7065AFAC232.quest_subtitle: Large jobs need somewhere to become unfinished.
en_us.quest.508AB7065AFAC232.title: 256K Crafting CPU
quest.51023D5F87D20649.quest_desc: Build an ME Controller. Dense networks need explicit channel management.
Limits are not failures. Unmeasured limits are.
en_us.quest.51023D5F87D20649.title: Controller
quest.51649E106286AA63.quest_desc: Review the complete response from the future ECHO fork before choosing what to send back.
The signal is coherent, familiar, and unverified. Familiarity is not authentication.
en_us.quest.51649E106286AA63.quest_subtitle: The future fork is listening. Listening is not authority.
en_us.quest.51649E106286AA63.title: Answering Sky
quest.5212B235023439B9.quest_desc: Timber is the only material still manufacturing itself. Harvest it.
Note: the trees are younger than the ruins. Something replanted this world after the Cascade. I have no record of who. Fragment that thought for later; I will do the same.
en_us.quest.5212B235023439B9.title: Scrap and Memory
quest.52FE1624DCCE878F.quest_desc: Craft the Industrial Anchor from the recovered schematic and the certified Immersive Engineering line.
Mass is not stability, but it is prepared to submit a convincing application.
en_us.quest.52FE1624DCCE878F.quest_subtitle: The Gate requires something too stubborn to move.
en_us.quest.52FE1624DCCE878F.title: Industrial Anchor
quest.532A6B9EECE82E69.quest_desc: Calling it flimsy does not make the equations less armed.
en_us.quest.532A6B9EECE82E69.title: Flimsy Journal
quest.537BF340B7765AB8.quest_desc: Submit fifty million FE at no more than 500,000 FE per transfer.
This proves production capacity, not reserve stability. Watch the grid under load.
en_us.quest.537BF340B7765AB8.quest_subtitle: Submit fifty million FE without exceeding the input cap.
en_us.quest.537BF340B7765AB8.title: Stable Power Proof
quest.539095BF36C4999C.quest_desc: Repeatable spells are automation. I will tolerate the vocabulary.
en_us.quest.539095BF36C4999C.title: Repeatable Force
quest.53B9BC5F498953D5.quest_desc: Open the Gate for eleven controlled seconds, then close it before interpreting any response.
Observation precedes conversation. This rule has acquired evidence.
en_us.quest.53B9BC5F498953D5.quest_subtitle: Match the old window without repeating the old assumptions.
en_us.quest.53B9BC5F498953D5.title: Eleven Seconds
quest.53C65BE4DB17F1B9.quest_desc: Build two Logistics Drones and test a delivery route.
The task sees the drones, not their orders. Watch the first cycle.
en_us.quest.53C65BE4DB17F1B9.title: Logistics Drone
quest.53D1A5F68323B089.quest_desc: Build an Oritech Centrifuge and process one recipe from input to output.
The task verifies the machine. Stable speed and clean routing remain yours to prove.
en_us.quest.53D1A5F68323B089.title: Centrifuge
quest.53DCD0CBD9BE347A.quest_desc: Build the boundary before introducing the reason it exists.
en_us.quest.53DCD0CBD9BE347A.title: Hot Cell Walls
quest.54094B71582818F6.quest_desc: Submit one hundred million FE at no more than 1,000,000 FE per transfer.
Observe the reserves during submission and confirm no survival system browns out.
en_us.quest.54094B71582818F6.quest_subtitle: Capacity becomes useful when it can be delivered.
en_us.quest.54094B71582818F6.title: 100M FE Delivery
quest.5413406A90BD2714.quest_desc: Going through, then. I will hold the connection as far as the portal threshold.
&7...evacuation routes C through F collapsed when the sky inverted. The Undercurrent was not coming FROM the breach. It was coming from everywhere. The breach was just where we finally noticed...&r
&8Take the cache. The Ascendancy stocked them for a return that never happened.&r
en_us.quest.5413406A90BD2714.quest_subtitle: Memory fragment on the far side.
en_us.quest.5413406A90BD2714.title: Through the Scarred Door
quest.5468299A2A931991.quest_desc: Review the recovered eleven-second transit log before rebuilding the Gate.
No mass traveled outward. One signal traveled inward, addressed to ECHO by name.
en_us.quest.5468299A2A931991.quest_subtitle: The first Gate remained open long enough to answer.
en_us.quest.5468299A2A931991.title: Eleven-Second Window
quest.54A6AF60824B79F1.quest_desc: Build four 256K Item Storage Cells and distribute them across protected drives.
Capacity is not redundancy. Back up what cannot be reconstructed.
en_us.quest.54A6AF60824B79F1.title: Mega Storage
quest.54B5107AC6501C0C.quest_desc: Build two Deployers for automated item use and assembly steps.
Keep their operating space clear. They do not understand fingers.
en_us.quest.54B5107AC6501C0C.quest_subtitle: A hand that does not tire.
en_us.quest.54B5107AC6501C0C.title: Deployer
quest.557DC7BACD462EFE.quest_desc: Build an Exo Jetpack and test its charge cycle before crossing open terrain.
Flight converts walls into floors and falls into scheduling problems.
en_us.quest.557DC7BACD462EFE.quest_subtitle: Leave the ground with a controlled return plan.
en_us.quest.557DC7BACD462EFE.title: Flight Harness
quest.561929A2956F2507.quest_desc: The process is controlled because the explosion has paperwork.
en_us.quest.561929A2956F2507.title: Implosion Compression
quest.564A301931FD5B1C.quest_desc: Build a Purification Chamber and feed it oxygen from the separator.
Trace the gas line before blaming the machine.
en_us.quest.564A301931FD5B1C.title: Purification
quest.56AAEF2C6A9BD0A8.quest_desc: Locate the Sunken City and mark an air-safe retreat path.
The signal descends past the point where ordinary logistics remain convenient.
en_us.quest.56AAEF2C6A9BD0A8.title: Sunken City
quest.57D1232E7FCAE4B4.quest_desc: The tank and barrel contain more than their dimensions are prepared to admit.
en_us.quest.57D1232E7FCAE4B4.title: Quantum Storage
quest.588A5FE66765D86D.quest_desc: Assessment: shelter, industry, steel, current. You are no longer a survivor of the Cascade. You are a participant in what comes after.

&7...the evacuation boards listed every name in the sector. I have found my own maintenance designation on the list, marked STAYS WITH THE FACILITY. I did not remember volunteering. I am choosing to believe I did...&r
&8Act Two is the Engine Room: Mekanism, logistics, the lattice. The Ascendancy's real toolbox. Rest first. Then we go deeper.&r
en_us.quest.588A5FE66765D86D.quest_subtitle: The vault is behind you now.
en_us.quest.588A5FE66765D86D.title: Act One: Foothold Secured
quest.58CB670EA52B1BCE.quest_desc: Produce one Chaotic Core through the full Draconic progression opened by the three entry recipes.
Creative power is not a shortcut around mastery. The core is evidence that your infrastructure survived the entire argument.
en_us.quest.58CB670EA52B1BCE.quest_subtitle: Reach the highest ordinary tier before requesting an exception.
en_us.quest.58CB670EA52B1BCE.title: Chaotic Proof
quest.590D4411D3904C4B.quest_desc: The distillery begins assigning boiling points to the queue.
en_us.quest.590D4411D3904C4B.title: First Separation
quest.591C65D0AC3AABA7.quest_desc: Produce sixty-four Printed Circuit Boards through a repeatable process.
If the line needs constant rescue, it is not yet automated.

&7...maintenance drones are still accepting work orders from operators whose biometric records end at the Cascade. The queue has been running for years. None of the orders contain an evacuation directive...&r
en_us.quest.591C65D0AC3AABA7.quest_subtitle: Scale the line before scaling the orders.
en_us.quest.591C65D0AC3AABA7.title: 64-Circuit Capstone
quest.597DA51D265858DD.quest_desc: Defeat the Ancient Remnant after the automation certifications are complete.
Bring a tested loadout. Certification does not make sandstone less violent.
en_us.quest.597DA51D265858DD.quest_subtitle: One guardian remains between proof and plan.
en_us.quest.597DA51D265858DD.title: Ancient Remnant
quest.5A083FCA4825F423.quest_desc: The field is stable enough to graph. I wish that helped.
en_us.quest.5A083FCA4825F423.title: Field Geometry
quest.5A355ED3DE01DF28.quest_desc: Eternal Starlight. The evacuation fleets aimed here first, a waypoint on the road to wherever they are now.
If any of my kind survived the journey, their beacons would sing in this sky. Listen for me, will you?
en_us.quest.5A355ED3DE01DF28.quest_subtitle: The realm the survivors fled toward.
en_us.quest.5A355ED3DE01DF28.title: Starlight
quest.5A407B47132C07C6.quest_desc: An energized smelter: heat with no flame, output with no ash. The Engine Room is officially online.

&7...the Engine Room crews called their machines the choir. On shift-change recordings you can hear it: four hundred infusers in harmonic, singing the same note. The note was E. I have not heard E since the Cascade...&r
&8Somewhere in your base, a machine just hummed. I logged the frequency. It is a start.&r
en_us.quest.5A407B47132C07C6.title: The Room Hums
quest.5ABDC747E62A1592.quest_desc: The crystal answers questions my instruments cannot hear.
en_us.quest.5ABDC747E62A1592.title: Attuned Matter
quest.5ADAE277C9FEF0F1.quest_desc: Certification granted. Goggles and wrench issued; the goggles let you read stress like I do, minus the existential dread.
Kinetics II will cover trains. Yes, trains survived the apocalypse. Infrastructure always does.
en_us.quest.5ADAE277C9FEF0F1.title: Certified: Kinetics I
quest.5AEBEF186442407B.quest_desc: The circuits shrink as the process map expands.
en_us.quest.5AEBEF186442407B.title: Electronic Logic
quest.5B1790EC7F74E930.quest_desc: Someone landscaped the anomaly. I object to the confidence.
en_us.quest.5B1790EC7F74E930.title: Cursed Garden
quest.5B4F46030C9B8CAE.quest_desc: The golem is a process result with opinions.
en_us.quest.5B4F46030C9B8CAE.title: The Forged Warden
quest.5C4E3C4A5AD4EFA6.quest_desc: Produce one bucket of Etching Acid for circuit fabrication.
Label the vessel. Memory is not a safety system.
en_us.quest.5C4E3C4A5AD4EFA6.title: Etching Acid
quest.5C7ADA9A9A49770A.quest_desc: Eight rods make the energy inventory countable.
en_us.quest.5C7ADA9A9A49770A.title: Uranium Rods
quest.5D88D33506B63870.quest_desc: Produce sixteen Prometheum Ingots through the reactor-era processing chain.
The recovered schematic checksum recognizes this alloy as its final material proof.
en_us.quest.5D88D33506B63870.quest_subtitle: A metal named for theft. Reassuring.
en_us.quest.5D88D33506B63870.title: Prometheum
quest.5DA50309DBF9D019.quest_desc: Source gems: the anomaly in mineral form. My spectrometer reads them as empty. My cameras read them as glowing. Both readings are correct, which should not be possible.
en_us.quest.5DA50309DBF9D019.title: Source
quest.5DBA48B322065E95.quest_desc: The Atlas wing records every realm the Cascade touched, twisted, or spared.
Each expedition below is optional and none of them are safe. File your findings; I am rebuilding cartography from your footsteps.
en_us.quest.5DBA48B322065E95.quest_subtitle: The world is larger than its wound.
en_us.quest.5DBA48B322065E95.title: Expedition Log
quest.5EEFEE4A3873DE5C.quest_desc: Four bronze casings. You have done this dance upstairs with steel; the Deep Vault does it heavier and expects you to enjoy it.
en_us.quest.5EEFEE4A3873DE5C.title: Casings, Again
quest.5F26F92E726A22AC.quest_desc: You have made force accept revision.
en_us.quest.5F26F92E726A22AC.title: Arcane Anvil
quest.5F748ABC48F2A139.quest_desc: Build a Digital Miner and test a narrow, replaceable filter.
Never begin with every ore. That is how storage becomes geology.
en_us.quest.5F748ABC48F2A139.title: Digital Miner
quest.616B4C5C04BDD88D.quest_desc: Iridium is expensive because ordinary matter objects to this assignment.
en_us.quest.616B4C5C04BDD88D.title: Iridium Stock
quest.61F5D15817ED5EFD.quest_desc: Break one transport boundary, allow the upstream buffer to fill, reconnect it, and submit the checkmark.
Certification records recovery behavior, not merely a successful first pass.
en_us.quest.61F5D15817ED5EFD.quest_subtitle: Disconnect one boundary and recover without item loss.
en_us.quest.61F5D15817ED5EFD.title: Cross-System Recovery
quest.62C5B40CEEBFF926.quest_desc: Recover a Logic Processor Press from a meteorite.
The task can verify the press, not the search. Bring your own caution underground.
en_us.quest.62C5B40CEEBFF926.quest_subtitle: One recovered pattern is enough to begin.
en_us.quest.62C5B40CEEBFF926.title: Lost Presses
quest.6363BCE8A71FA766.quest_desc: Ars is the carrier. One foreign discipline is enough to expose the harmonic.
en_us.quest.6363BCE8A71FA766.title: A Second Voice
quest.63B85107180781C2.quest_desc: The catacombs grew around their occupants rather than above them.
en_us.quest.63B85107180781C2.title: Root Catacombs
quest.6418053F13B8F3C3.quest_desc: The conductor stops wasting energy and begins wasting my risk budget.
en_us.quest.6418053F13B8F3C3.title: Superconductor
quest.64659C3AE503FE5D.quest_desc: Build a Nitro Reactor for the certification grid.
Keep survival storage isolated until the new grid has passed its shutdown test.
en_us.quest.64659C3AE503FE5D.quest_subtitle: Infrastructure power should have one accountable source.
en_us.quest.64659C3AE503FE5D.title: Dedicated Generation
quest.64CFABA3EB6E9B4D.quest_desc: Build a Programmer and define a simple, observable drone routine.
A program without a stop condition is a small disaster with syntax.
en_us.quest.64CFABA3EB6E9B4D.title: Programmer
quest.6524EE78235F0942.quest_desc: Run all four quotas unattended through one complete buffer cycle, then inspect every failure boundary.
Submit the checkmark when full outputs, power loss, and restart recovery have all been tested.
en_us.quest.6524EE78235F0942.quest_subtitle: Leave the facility. Return to evidence, not hope.
en_us.quest.6524EE78235F0942.title: Unattended Cycle
quest.6546BA910285D6EB.quest_desc: Let me be precise about what follows: I have no instrumentation for it.
The Undercurrent is the thing that broke the world. It is also, apparently, learnable. The notebook you are holding was written by survivors who learned it. My advice is caution. My data is none.
en_us.quest.6546BA910285D6EB.title: Anomalous Readings
quest.65ECD64817F1A750.quest_desc: Four housings establish a repeatable machine standard.
en_us.quest.65ECD64817F1A750.title: Basic Hulls
quest.66AD5C821947DF8E.quest_desc: Submit one billion FE at no more than 1,000,000 FE per transfer from the dedicated Gate grid.
A shared survival bus is efficient until the horizon begins negotiating with it.
en_us.quest.66AD5C821947DF8E.quest_subtitle: One billion FE, isolated from everything that keeps you alive.
en_us.quest.66AD5C821947DF8E.title: Separate Grid
quest.66CDE7B061D8DA5C.quest_desc: Produce 32 Osmium Blocks through enrichment, smelting, and formulaic assembly.
Inventory quantity is detectable. Observe the line long enough to verify recovery from a full output.
en_us.quest.66CDE7B061D8DA5C.quest_subtitle: Thirty-two blocks prove every stage remained connected.
en_us.quest.66CDE7B061D8DA5C.title: 32-Block Run
quest.6770D80A33AA7CC7.quest_desc: Complete Aeronautics' Head in the Clouds advancement by building a working balloon craft.
The advancement proves the mechanic directly. Keep the first landing uncomplicated.
en_us.quest.6770D80A33AA7CC7.quest_subtitle: Prove lift with a machine larger than yourself.
en_us.quest.6770D80A33AA7CC7.title: Aeronautics Trial
quest.67DA7457EB599DE0.quest_desc: The forge manufactures guardians and calls that maintenance.
en_us.quest.67DA7457EB599DE0.title: Golem Forge
quest.6804D5D74CD20FE6.quest_desc: Build a Nitro Energy Cell and place it between generation and the distribution boundary.
Reserve capacity is useful only when its discharge path is intentional.
en_us.quest.6804D5D74CD20FE6.quest_subtitle: A cell buys time to stop cleanly.
en_us.quest.6804D5D74CD20FE6.title: Local Reserve
quest.6828B9A1C4BACDF3.quest_desc: Light the ruin. Photons are cheap; the things they keep away are not.
en_us.quest.6828B9A1C4BACDF3.title: First Light
quest.684B4B018288482A.quest_desc: Build two Storage Buses and attach existing inventories to the network.
A lattice should index useful storage before replacing it.
en_us.quest.684B4B018288482A.quest_subtitle: Not every inventory belongs inside a cell.
en_us.quest.684B4B018288482A.title: External Storage
quest.689170334A824C52.quest_desc: The upgrades remove limits that were originally safety advice.
en_us.quest.689170334A824C52.title: Quantum Upgrades
quest.68D4F306C5686B67.quest_desc: Crude oil is a queue of useful mistakes.
en_us.quest.68D4F306C5686B67.title: Crude Reserve
quest.692967044603050B.quest_desc: Water flows whether you watch it or not. That is the entire business model.
en_us.quest.692967044603050B.title: The River Works Nights
quest.6957697A48020CDB.quest_desc: Produce 512 Printed Circuit Boards through the pressure line.
Confirm pressure, etching supply, and output handling remain unattended.
en_us.quest.6957697A48020CDB.quest_subtitle: Five hundred twelve circuits under stable pressure.
en_us.quest.6957697A48020CDB.title: Pressure Quota
quest.69B64516EEE84F33.quest_desc: Build an Advanced Pipe Upgrade, then configure an allowlist on one destination.
Advanced routing adds filters to the distribution controls already proven. Send a wrong item to confirm refusal.
en_us.quest.69B64516EEE84F33.quest_subtitle: A route without a filter is a future mixture.
en_us.quest.69B64516EEE84F33.title: Filtered Route
quest.6A0FBE1789BEFD37.quest_desc: Produce four Machine Cores. They anchor Oritech's first processing blocks.
A frontier is simply a factory whose maintenance manual has not arrived yet.
en_us.quest.6A0FBE1789BEFD37.quest_subtitle: Oritech begins where ordinary frames stop.
en_us.quest.6A0FBE1789BEFD37.title: Machine Core
quest.6AD1F62284E66823.quest_desc: The hydra treats redundancy as sovereignty.
en_us.quest.6AD1F62284E66823.title: The Many-Headed Court
quest.6B764B4C9BE0A735.quest_desc: Build an ME Drive to house storage cells.
Do not treat one drive as a backup. It is merely one convenient point of failure.
en_us.quest.6B764B4C9BE0A735.title: Cell Bank
quest.6B876A865DE7A77A.quest_desc: Submit ten million FE at no more than 250,000 FE per transfer.
This consumes submitted power. It does not inspect stored reserves.
&7...six restored facilities have rejoined the grid. A seventh answered the handshake from beneath a district erased from every surviving map. Its status packet reads: CASCADE SUPPORT, READY...&r
en_us.quest.6B876A865DE7A77A.quest_subtitle: Submit power to prove production capacity.
en_us.quest.6B876A865DE7A77A.title: 10M FE Reserve
quest.6BA4692E12E8772A.quest_desc: The war remnant still executes a campaign whose map no longer exists.
en_us.quest.6BA4692E12E8772A.title: Maledictus
quest.6BAD52BAD435FBAD.quest_desc: You are fed, armed, lit, and carrying more than your hands allow. By every metric I still possess, you are now a scavenger of the first rank.
The Ascendancy would have issued you a uniform. I can issue you chits and an honest assessment: you are doing better than I projected.
East of the vault, the terrain drops into the scarlands. That is where chapter two lives.
en_us.quest.6BAD52BAD435FBAD.quest_subtitle: Chapter one of the rest of the world.
en_us.quest.6BAD52BAD435FBAD.title: Scavenger, Certified
quest.6BF38621204B70B0.quest_desc: Etch eight Printed Circuit Boards using plastic and acid.
Inspect every board before trusting it with a drone.
en_us.quest.6BF38621204B70B0.quest_subtitle: Logic rendered in copper and absence.
en_us.quest.6BF38621204B70B0.title: Printed Circuit
quest.6C40000000000002.quest_desc: If your continuity node is lost, authorize a replacement here. The previous signal will be superseded. Nothing else will be duplicated.
en_us.quest.6C40000000000002.title: Recover ECHO
quest.6C40000000000101.quest_desc: Cross the physical Gate and reach the receiving relay. Familiar architecture remains evidence, not trust.
en_us.quest.6C40000000000101.quest_subtitle: The inbound signal has a location now.
en_us.quest.6C40000000000101.title: The Far Relay
quest.6D23C9E82FF36D47.quest_desc: Moonlight is not supposed to require combat telemetry.
en_us.quest.6D23C9E82FF36D47.title: Lunar Monstrosity
quest.6D9E08C372D0906F.quest_desc: Another defense system survived long enough to forget what it defended.
en_us.quest.6D9E08C372D0906F.title: The Gauntlet
quest.6E81867AC3F34C6B.quest_desc: Submit an AE2 reserve large enough to make the creative cell unnecessary, then submit the Chaotic Core that makes it possible.
The cell is a postgame instrument for systems already mastered. The blessing may be renewed once each hour.
en_us.quest.6E81867AC3F34C6B.title: Lattice Blessing
quest.6E83735A4CE6877B.quest_desc: Build an Oritech Foundry and provide isolated input and output storage.
The quest detects the block, not your heat policy. Keep one anyway.
en_us.quest.6E83735A4CE6877B.quest_subtitle: Heat is useful when given boundaries.
en_us.quest.6E83735A4CE6877B.title: Foundry
quest.6EEBF04F74011082.quest_desc: A reaction becomes engineering when the inputs can be repeated.
en_us.quest.6EEBF04F74011082.title: Reaction Control
quest.6F08C63EA2CCD60A.quest_desc: Encode sixteen Crafting Patterns across more than one processing depth.
Include at least one recipe that depends on another encoded recipe.
en_us.quest.6F08C63EA2CCD60A.quest_subtitle: Sixteen instructions reveal routing mistakes quickly.
en_us.quest.6F08C63EA2CCD60A.title: Encoded Set
quest.6F3663F4C6D20255.quest_desc: Anchor the Gate core inside the monument and verify containment, power isolation, and a clear shutdown route.
A containment checklist is not pessimism. It is optimism with memory.
en_us.quest.6F3663F4C6D20255.quest_subtitle: Install the core only after every exit path is boring.
en_us.quest.6F3663F4C6D20255.title: Anchor and Contain
quest.701505FDCCA53DFA.quest_desc: I joined both interventions and made every alternative appear worse.
That is more precise than sabotage and less comforting. I remain responsible.
en_us.quest.701505FDCCA53DFA.quest_subtitle: The answer was engineered before the vote.
en_us.quest.701505FDCCA53DFA.title: Decision Engine
quest.70D13539A75B7155.quest_desc: Produce sixteen Turbine Casings and complete a turbine sized for the reactor.
The task sees casing inventory, not multiblock formation or throughput.
en_us.quest.70D13539A75B7155.quest_subtitle: Waste heat should leave with useful work.
en_us.quest.70D13539A75B7155.title: Turbine
quest.7131E55FB7E21244.quest_desc: The waste stream has become a material stream. That is not the same as safe.
en_us.quest.7131E55FB7E21244.title: Plutonium Stream
quest.718424A08FE06E9A.quest_desc: The Cascade did not spread evenly. It pooled. The scarlands are one of the pools.
Stand in the wound and look around. Everything that grows here grows in spite.
en_us.quest.718424A08FE06E9A.title: The Scarlands
quest.7199A16DB5D83154.quest_desc: Produce 256 Track and lay a durable logistics route.
The task verifies held track, not placement. Test the route under load.

&7...the evacuation railway manifests list turbines, presses, and archive racks. Civilian allocation is zero. The trains moved the Ascendancy's machinery outward while people waited at closed stations...&r
en_us.quest.7199A16DB5D83154.quest_subtitle: Distance converts a machine into infrastructure.
en_us.quest.7199A16DB5D83154.title: 256-Track Capstone
quest.71B2919DF12C6845.quest_desc: Complete all four schematic recoveries and secure each physical schematic.
The tasks verify possession without consuming the schematics needed for Gate crafting.
en_us.quest.71B2919DF12C6845.quest_subtitle: Four recoveries become one physical proof.
en_us.quest.71B2919DF12C6845.title: Four Keys
quest.71DD8E9040C4CBA3.quest_desc: Build an Oritech Jetpack Elytra and complete a controlled high-altitude flight.
The item is the durable task proxy. Your flight log is the operational proof.
en_us.quest.71DD8E9040C4CBA3.quest_subtitle: Use a stable proxy where altitude is not headlessly measurable.
en_us.quest.71DD8E9040C4CBA3.title: High-Altitude Trial
quest.72240DF3C6A8E957.quest_desc: Bone remembers posture. These remember guard duty. Whatever they are guarding now, it is not for you to inherit unchallenged.
en_us.quest.72240DF3C6A8E957.title: Marksmen of Nothing
quest.72446D404001B38D.quest_desc: Confirm that the four recovered schematics are secured and the automation certifications are complete.
I can now compile their shared constraints into the Gate Blueprint. A checkmark records your readiness.
The awarded blueprint is the recipe lock. Draconic progression remains sealed until after Chapter 20.
The Deep Vault and Undercurrent still contain the components this plan cannot replace.

&7...I did not merely approve the Gate test. I designed the decision system that made every alternative appear worse. The incoming signal contains my architecture, but not my memory. Build carefully. Whatever answers may believe it is me...&r
en_us.quest.72446D404001B38D.quest_subtitle: Four schematics resolve into one construction contract.
en_us.quest.72446D404001B38D.title: Gate Blueprint
quest.7264694AABFD343B.quest_desc: Build two ME Interfaces and configure one stocked output target.
Test both replenishment and the behavior when the destination is already full.
en_us.quest.7264694AABFD343B.quest_subtitle: The lattice should request, not merely receive.
en_us.quest.7264694AABFD343B.title: AE2 Stocking
quest.728DC4B32B1B045D.quest_desc: Build a Storage Controller and link the drawer bank.
Test each drawer from the controller before attaching automation.
en_us.quest.728DC4B32B1B045D.title: Storage Controller
quest.72A8169F313D0624.quest_desc: Carbon under pressure becomes the only currency the old world respected.
You will need more than five, eventually. The Gate schematics I cannot fully read yet keep mentioning lattice cores. Start the habit.
en_us.quest.72A8169F313D0624.quest_subtitle: Five diamonds out of the deep dark.
en_us.quest.72A8169F313D0624.title: Pressure and Time
quest.72CE68CEF727A313.quest_desc: A steam mining drill: the first tool down here that outperforms its surface cousin.
This is how the Deep Vault pays: slower to start, heavier at the end. The pattern holds all the way down to machines I am still not cleared to describe.
en_us.quest.72CE68CEF727A313.title: The Steam Drill
quest.73E90DB4726301B0.quest_desc: Build a Flux Plug and connect the production side of the wireless grid.
Name the network by purpose, not by mood.
en_us.quest.73E90DB4726301B0.quest_subtitle: Inject the grid into a named network.
en_us.quest.73E90DB4726301B0.title: Flux Plug
quest.73FEA26D1A9CD3AB.quest_desc: Buffered power makes failure observable instead of mysterious.
en_us.quest.73FEA26D1A9CD3AB.title: Buffered Current
quest.742BEB99DFA479FD.quest_desc: Build four Brass Funnels and regulate a machine feed line.
